limitations: Source fingerprints are measured at import and matched to caller expectations; no source reread occurs during pure projection.
No fitted covariance, VaR, trading policy, account NAV, margin, leverage or execution result is established.
This review did not recompute actual financial evidence or validate a live source mapper.
review_scope: Bounded independent read-only module and test source review, with owner XML inspection. No independent test rerun, real position/quote reads, runtime writes, model fitting or broker calls.
reviewed_boundaries: Single explicitly named caller-attested virtual scenario; no cross-arm aggregation.
Existing positions preserve their original integer units; candidate is additive only.
Every supplied quote and state availability is at or before the original decision cutoff; later observed clock cannot unlock a future quote.
Marked signed base/quote risk units use current midpoint, independent of financed entry cash or account holdings.
EUR/GBP direct and JPY inverse USD midpoint valuation; conservative absolute conversion uses purchase-side bid/ask rates.
Gross position notional and two-leg currency attribution are distinct; netting never erases gross or directional counts.
Invalid/missing required valuation fails the whole projection; supplied diagnostic count/notional/net/gross/concentration limits do not authorize execution.
Private192-digit Decimal context and bounded decimal inputs avoid dependence on ambient arithmetic precision.
Original source and record hashes remain explicit caller/module-load attestations, not independent authentication of account state.
